Quick asks so we can prioritize:
- Audit period you need included in the report (e.g., 2027-07-01 to 2028-01-31) — please confirm.
- Preferred transfer method (presigned S3 preferred for large bundles).
- Any PO / procurement contact that needs a DocuSign bridge-letter path.

I've attached: soc2-request-checklist.xlsx (artifact matrix), a sample bridge letter (word) and short reply templates for procurement to use.

If you want a single ZIP with the report + bridge letter + log samples, we can provision a short-lived presigned URL and send upload instructions.

Next step: if you confirm the audit period and preferred upload route, I'll send the presigned link and a short procurement-ready message you can forward.
